description: Look up the curated catalog of CC0 asset sites, each with its license page, scope and dated evidence, plus popular 'free' sites that are NOT CC0 (e.g. Unsplash, Pixabay) and candidates still pending verification. Use it to answer 'is site X CC0?' (pass the site name or domain as `query`) or to suggest sites to browse by hand (pass `kind`, and a topic as `query`); use search_assets instead to find actual assets. The catalog holds several hundred sites, so each of the three lists returns one page of `limit` entries and `totals` gives the full match counts. Behavior: reads a bundled JSON file, so no network access, instant and deterministic.

kind.description: Keep only sources offering this asset type ('font' is catalog-only); 'any' (default) keeps all. Does not filter the notCc0 and pending lists

page.description: 1-based page, applied to each list; request page 2+ only if `totals` shows more matches

query.description: Site name, domain or topic words, e.g. 'unsplash', 'kenney.nl' or 'pixel art'. Keeps entries in all three lists whose id, name, URL, notes or reason contain every word (case-insensitive). Leave out to page through everything

name: list_sources

notCc0.description: Popular 'free' sites that are NOT CC0, on this page

pendingVerification.description: Candidates whose license could not be verified yet, on this page

sources.description: Verified CC0 sources on this page

scope.description: whole-library: everything is CC0; filter-only: only CC0-labeled items qualify

searchable.description: true if search_assets queries this source

evidence.description: Text or field that was checked

totals.description: Matches per list before paging. When a total exceeds `limit`, narrow with `query` or request the next `page`

title: List verified CC0 source sites
